screening_decisions.reason: Randomized trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) with terbutaline for tocolysis in women at 26-32 weeks gestation with preterm labor. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Not a randomized trial; observational study of placental transfer of indomethacin given before cordocentesis procedures, not for tocolysis.
Cochrane review about magnesium sulphate for neuroprotection, not a primary RCT of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of celecoxib (COX-2 selective inhibitor) for tocolysis in women at 24-34 weeks gestation with preterm labor.
Randomized, double-blind trial comparing sulindac (COX inhibitor) with terbutaline for tocolysis in women at approximately 32 weeks gestation with preterm labor.
Cochrane review about progestational agents, not a primary RCT of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Methodological paper about statistical analysis methods, not a clinical trial of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Prospective, double-blind randomized trial comparing ritodrine+placebo with ritodrine+indomethacin (COX inhibitor) for tocolysis in threatened preterm labor.
Randomized, double-blind, double-dummy trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) with nylidrin for tocolysis in women at 25-34 weeks gestation with imminent preterm labor.
Retrospective matched cohort study, not a randomized trial. Examines neonatal outcomes after indomethacin exposure.
Methodological paper about statistical analysis methods, not a clinical trial of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.

While this is an RCT of rofecoxib (COX-2 inhibitor), it was for prophylactic/preventive use in women at high risk, not for tocolysis in women actively in labour. Selection criteria specify 'women in labour'.
Randomized, double-masked trial of indomethacin (COX inhibitor) for tocolysis in women with PPROM at 24-31 6/7 weeks gestation.
Randomized trial comparing indomethacin and sulindac (both COX inhibitors) for tocolysis in women with refractory preterm labor at approximately 29-30 weeks gestation.
Although randomized, this study enrolled normal low-risk patients WITHOUT signs of preterm labor to study fetal breathing movements, not for tocolysis treatment.
Prospective randomized double-blind trial of indomethacin (COX inhibitor) versus placebo for tocolysis in premature labor.
Prospective randomized trial comparing ketorolac (NSAID/COX inhibitor) with magnesium sulfate for tocolysis in women at ≤32 weeks gestation with preterm labor.
Systematic review and network meta-analysis, not a primary randomized trial.
Cochrane review about betamimetics, not a primary RCT of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Randomized prospective trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) with ritodrine for tocolysis in women at 23-34 weeks gestation with preterm labor.
In vitro animal experimental study using rat myometrial strips, not a human randomized trial.
Randomized placebo-controlled trial of indomethacin (COX inhibitor) for tocolysis in women at 23-30 weeks gestation with preterm labor.
Randomized trial comparing celecoxib (COX-2 selective inhibitor) with magnesium sulfate for tocolysis in women at 24-34 weeks gestation with preterm labor.
Historical review article, not a primary randomized trial.
Although randomized, this study enrolled normal low-risk patients WITHOUT signs of preterm labor to study umbilical artery impedance, not for tocolysis treatment.
Basic science study examining COX expression in myometrium, not a clinical trial of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Double-blind randomized trial of ampicillin-sulbactam plus indomethacin (COX inhibitor) versus placebos as adjunctive tocolysis in women with mean gestational age 30.1 weeks.
Cochrane review about antenatal corticosteroids, not a primary RCT of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Retrospective review of neonatal intensive care data, not a randomized trial.
Observational study examining progesterone levels, not a randomized trial of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Randomized trial where women in preterm labor at 26-33 weeks gestation were randomly allocated to receive indomethacin (COX inhibitor) or nylidrin for tocolysis.
Structured literature review about economic consequences, not a primary randomized trial.
Qualitative study using grounded theory techniques, not a randomized trial.
Observational study examining COMT activity; while some women received indomethacin, this does not appear to be a randomized trial designed to evaluate tocolysis efficacy.
Retrospective cohort study about delivery sites, not a randomized trial of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Cochrane review about calcium channel blockers, not a primary RCT of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Randomized double-blind trial of mefenamic acid (NSAID/COX inhibitor) versus placebo for prevention of premature labour in women at risk.
Randomized study comparing indomethacin and sulindac (both COX inhibitors) for tocolysis in women at 28-32 weeks gestation with threatened preterm labor.

Comparative trial evaluating ethanol, salbutamol, and combination of ethanol+indomethacin (COX inhibitor) for tocolysis in preterm labor. Conservative inclusion pending clarification of randomization.
Randomized trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) with magnesium sulfate for tocolysis in women at <30 weeks gestation with preterm labor.
Single-arm observational study of 297 women receiving indomethacin, no control group, not a randomized trial.
Meta-analysis of existing studies, not a primary randomized trial.
In vitro organ culture study using serum-free organ culture, not a human randomized trial.
Randomized double-blind trial of mefenamic acid (NSAID/COX inhibitor) versus placebo for prevention of premature labour. Note: Appears to be duplicate of study 37.
Cochrane review about combination tocolytic agents, not a primary RCT of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Review article about epidemiology of preterm birth, not a primary randomized trial.
Meta-analysis of maintenance tocolytic therapy, not a primary randomized trial.
Randomized trial comparing three tocolytics including indomethacin (COX inhibitor) in women with average gestational age 28.6 weeks with preterm labor.
Community-based cohort study following up preterm infants, not a randomized trial of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Randomized trial comparing indomethacin (COX inhibitor) with magnesium sulfate for tocolysis in women at <32 weeks gestation with preterm labor.
Matched retrospective cohort study, not a randomized trial.
Cochrane review about nitric oxide donors, not a primary RCT of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Review article about prostaglandin synthetase inhibitors, not a primary randomized trial.
Population-based database study, not a randomized trial of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Randomized trial comparing rofecoxib (COX-2 selective inhibitor) with magnesium sulfate for tocolysis in women at 22-34 weeks gestation with preterm labor.
Cochrane review about magnesium sulphate, not a primary RCT of COX inhibitors for tocolysis.
Double-blind, double-dummy randomized trial comparing indomethacin, sulindac, and nimesulide (all COX inhibitors) for tocolysis in women at 28-32 weeks gestation with preterm contractions.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind trial of indomethacin (COX inhibitor) versus placebo for tocolysis in premature labor.
